title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: When to sub
hook: How do you decide when to sub a player out?
intro: Another has been waiting on the bench a while.
statement: A sub plan protects you from forgetting a kid.
q1: Do you sub on a set clock —
q2: or watch the game and sub by feel?
q3: Who has been on the bench longest?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids trust the system
t2: when subs feel fair and predictable.
ctaLines: Every five minutes. By feel. A sub chart.
ctaPrompt: Share your sub habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do you decide when to sub a player out?
One player looks tired. Another has been waiting on the bench a while.
A sub plan protects you from forgetting a kid.
Sub by the clock or by feel. There is no perfect answer.
How do you sub? Share your habit in the comments.
